notablePrerequisites: You have at least three permanent cards in your graveyard.
description:
Activate Matzalantli, the Great Door // The Core by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}{W}.
Activate Gleaming Splendor by paying {2}{W}, causing you and an opponent to draw a card.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Matzalantli, the Great Door // The Core.
Repeat.

uses.name: Matzalantli, the Great Door // The Core
